# Animal

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/animal.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/animal.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

An animal of the library next to a Transform (uniform scale): which clip it plays and the cross fade from the previous one.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `species` | `uint32_t` | Index in AnimalLibrary::entries. |
| `clip` | `int` | Index in the species' clips, -1: the bind pose. |
| `time` | `float` | Seconds in the clip. |
| `rate` | `float` | Playback speed (1). |
| `in_place` | `bool` | True: the clip's root motion is taken out, the Transform moves the animal. |
| `previous` | `int` | The clip it fades from, -1 for the bind pose. |
| `previous_time` | `float` | Seconds in that clip. |
| `previous_rate` | `float` | Its playback speed. |
| `fade` | `float` | Seconds since the change. |
| `fade_duration` | `float` | Seconds of the cross fade. |

## Notes

play(next, seconds = 0.3) starts a clip with a cross fade (no-op when it already plays). Made by Herds, AnimalLineup, AnimalWalkers, MountSpawn, AnimalAgentView and others; AnimalAnimation advances it, AnimalPass draws it.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md)**
  - Loads the animal library index (preinit) and the viewed species (first tick) from disk on the main thread; logs which.
  - With "log", opens the file once (truncated) and appends a CSV line every frame, flushed.
  - ImGui window "Animal".
  - Creates host entities (one skin per world with a built bot, 800 tiles with marks) that are never destroyed (no finish).
- **[AnimalAnimation](../systems/AnimalAnimation.md)**
  - Reads resources/animals/library.json and each species' .json, .bin and .anim on first use.
  - Logs the library's size or absence, and each species that fails to load.
  - Runs taskflow tasks (batches of 16 animals when there are more than 32) and waits for them.
- **[AnimalGait](../systems/AnimalGait.md)**
  - Logs one line per species and gait clip analysed.
  - Queries the ground field several times per foot per frame.
- **[AnimalLineup](../systems/AnimalLineup.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species, the origin, and each animal's place, height and clip count.
- **[AnimalWalkers](../systems/AnimalWalkers.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species or walks and each animal's clip, speed, radius and place.
  - Queries the ground field per animal per tick.
- **[Herds](../systems/Herds.md)**
  - Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
  - Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
  - Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
  - Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.
- **[MountSpawn](../systems/MountSpawn.md)**
  - Creates `count` animal entities in init.
  - Logs a warning `MountSpawn : no animal <species> in the library` and makes nothing when the species is missing.
  - Without a GroundField but with a terrain, builds a TerrainField (with its own MarchingCubes) for the ground heights.
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
- **[SteeredWalk](../systems/SteeredWalk.md)**
  - Adds and removes the SteeredWalk component, which Herds watches to let go of and take back its members.
  - Queries the ground field per walking animal per tick.
- **[animals](../systems/pass-animals.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers; uploads buffers and textures.
  - Writes the skinning matrices of the frame into a mapped storage buffer per frame in flight.
  - With ray tracing records animal_skin.rt.comp.glsl dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Logs species loaded and failures, and a warning past 65536 joints in view.
